instruction: Broken Driver Expression `/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend` contains two mesh objects, `Source` and `Driven`. `Driven.location.y` is supposed to follow `Source.location.x` via a driver, but it doesn't — `Driven.location.y` stays at 0 no matter what `Source.location.x` is set to. Diagnose and fix the driver so the link works, then save the result to `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` (relative to the working directory). ## Requirements 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend` opens as a valid Blender file. 2. Both `Source` and `Driven` exist in the scene. 3. `Driven` has at least one active driver on `location[1]` (its y component). 4. All data paths referenced by that driver resolve without error, and the driver reports as valid. 5. After a scene update at frame 1, `Driven.location.y` equals `Source.location.x` within 1e-3. 6. If `Source.location.x` is subsequently set to 5.0 and the scene is re-evaluated, `Driven.location.y` becomes 5.0 within 1e-3 — i.e. the driver re-evaluates on input changes. [Software] Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal.
